correctness.rationale: The normalized Fock kernel yields exp((exp(i theta)-1)|z|^2). Differentiating F_a(t)=exp(at)(cos t-a sin t) proves exactly one terminal root in (pi,2pi). An exhaustive analytic support-function comparison of the initial point against the earliest positive local maximum on every normal direction establishes the spiral-arc plus tangent-chord boundary, with later turns dominated geometrically. Green integration proves the area, arc length plus chord the perimeter. Radial contraction relative to a hull containing zero proves strict nesting; Taylor and implicit estimates establish both asymptotic regimes. The Fock monomial basis gives the irrational-rotation numerical-range disk. CHECK.py passed 120446 supplementary finite inequalities and polygonal comparisons; these do not replace the analytic proof.
